ideas.name: any warning on a balance day
ideas.why: a day that has crossed VWAP four or more times is rotating; turns called there come true

ideas.name: flip1 its way on a trend day
ideas.why: after 10:00, a day that has crossed VWAP at most once is trending; flips its way (with price on that side of VWAP) carry

ideas.name: any warning toward settlement on a far day
ideas.why: on a day 0.4 of its range from settlement (a trend day), warnings calling a turn back toward settlement fight the trend (expected to hurt)

ideas.name: narrow initial balance, its break continues
ideas.why: a first hour under 0.35 of the usual range leaves the day's range to be made later; the break of that hour starts it

ideas.name: wide initial balance, fade its edges
ideas.why: a first hour over 0.8 of the usual range has spent the day's range; tests of its edges reverse
